faqs.a:
Relief from the requirements of this division may be granted by the chief building
               official upon satisfactory demonstration by the appellant that the water conservation
               requirements stipulated herein are detrimental to health or safety. The city council
               may waive the enforcement of the requirements of this division if the city council
               finds and determines that such enforcement creates a financial hardship upon any person.
(Code 1981, § 33-55; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988)
